fullDescription: A premium, high-contrast interactive ISP or SaaS style guide featuring a deep navy hero section, vibrant orange and lime green accents, and sophisticated typography. The design utilizes 'Outfit' for headlines and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body text, creating a modern, technical aesthetic. Key features include 3D tilt interactions on pricing cards, smooth scroll-triggered reveal animations, glassmorphism elements, and a dynamic bento-grid portal dashboard. Ideal for fintech, telecommunications, or high-end service platforms requiring a balance of trust and energetic performance.
prompt:
## Resumo
Professional, interactive premium tech interface with high-contrast color blocks, glassmorphism, and depth-focused UI elements.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system with a primary color palette of Deep Navy (#002d5b), Vibrant Orange (#FF6B35), Lime Green (#84cc16), and Dark Teal (#1A7F7E). Typography: Headers in 'Outfit' (weights 600, 700) with -0.02em letter-spacing; Body text in 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (weights 300, 400, 500). Buttons should use a 350ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) transition, featuring a translate-y-[-3px] hover effect and a soft glow shadow (0 12px 24px -8px). Inputs must be pill-shaped with a 1px solid #e2e8f0 border and a #1A7F7E focus ring. Use glassmorphism (white/5% opacity with 10px blur) for dark-background cards and deep shadows for light-background cards.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky Header
Construct a sticky navigation bar with a deep navy (#002d5b) background and 10% white border at the bottom. The logo should sit on the left with a primary icon and bold type. Navigation links should have a custom underline hover effect where a 2px orange (#FF6B35) bar expands from 0 to 100% width on hover. The right side contains icon buttons for utility and a pill-shaped 'Contact' button with a 2px white border.

### Split Hero Section
Design a hero section with a #002d5b gradient background. On the left: a massive headline using 'Outfit' font at 8xl size, utilizing 'reveal-line' animation where text slides up into view. Below it, a high-contrast lime green (#84cc16) CTA button. On the right: a floating white form card with 40px rounded corners and deep shadows. Behind the card, integrate an 85% opacity subject image using 'mix-blend-multiply' to merge with the navy background. Include background parallax shapes (blobs) that shift slightly on mouse movement.

### Trust & Metric Bar
A white-background section featuring a logo row for ratings (Google, Trustpilot) followed by a 4-column grid of animated counters. Numbers should use tabular-nums formatting and count up to target values (e.g., 50,000+, 99.9%) using a 1500ms cubic-bezier ease-out when they enter the viewport.

### Solutions Carousel
Implement a horizontal scroll area on a light off-white (#fafaf7) background. Cards should be 300px minimum width with 32px corner radii. Each card contains a 56px square icon container with 6-degree rotation on hover. Use an 'Intersection Observer' to stagger the entrance of these cards with a scale-up animation (reveal-scale).

### 3D Pricing Grid
Create a 4-column pricing section on a deep navy background. Cards must implement a 3D tilt effect on mousemove (rotating max 8 degrees on X and Y axes). The 'Popular' card should be scaled 1.05x and feature a white background with a pulsing orange badge at the top. Other cards should use a glassmorphism style: white/5% opacity background, 10% white border, and 10px blur.

### Bento Portal Section
A two-column section with a large #FAFAF7 container (60px radius). The right column features a 'mock dashboard' card containing: user profile initial-circles, status badges with pulsing green lights, a dark navy usage card with a large orange infinity icon, and a list of connected device icons (mobile, monitor) with status indicators.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Interactive Tilt Pricing Card — Cards that react to mouse position to simulate 3D depth.
Apply 'transform-style: preserve-3d' and 'will-change: transform' to a card. On mousemove, calculate the relative X and Y positions within the card and apply 'rotateX' and 'rotateY' values between -8deg and 8deg. Include a 350ms ease-out transition on the transform property to ensure smooth movement.

### Service Status Badge — A micro-component for showing 'Active' or 'Online' states.
A pill-shaped badge with 10% opacity background of the status color (e.g., #84cc16). Inside, a 6px solid circle with a matching pulse animation (scale from 1 to 1.5 and fade out) next to uppercase 10px bold text.

### Reveal-Line Animation — High-end typography entry effect.
Wrap lines of text in a container with 'overflow: hidden'. The inner span should start at 'transform: translateY(100%) rotate(1deg)' with 0 opacity. On scroll, transition to 'translateY(0) rotate(0deg)' with opacity 1 using a timing function of cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) over 900ms.

style.description: The style is defined by a bold 'Dark Mode' hero against a 'Light Mode' body, using high-impact accent colors for call-to-actions. Typography pairings involve 'Outfit' for a geometric, technical header feel and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for readable, modern body copy. Motion is central, featuring 3D card tilts, mouse-parallax floating blobs, and cubic-bezier driven entrance animations.
